targets.text: Mineralization is associated with graphitic fault zones and a 2 km long sandstone resistivity low. Drilling has intersected basement structure, sandstone alteration, and localized uranium mineralization, including 0.123% U₃O₈ over 0.7 m in hole MZE-11-03 (619.

Exploration Potential In addition to defined mineralized zones, the property contains more than 35 km of untested conductive trends associated with low magnetic response, indicative of prospective graphitic basement rocks.

Numerous additional conductive corridors and targets across the property, including Blue Steel, Kowalchuk, Little Man Lake and other historically defined target areas, remain untested or underexplored by recent drilling.
